name: Intermediary 46
definition: Identification of a party and its role.

Identification.name: Identification
Identification.definition: Unique and unambiguous identifier for an organisation that is allocated by an institution.

LegalEntityIdentifier.name: Legal Entity Identifier
LegalEntityIdentifier.definition: Identification of the organisation with a Legal Entity Identifier. This is a code allocated to a party as described in ISO 17442 "Financial Services - Legal Entity Identifier (LEI)".

Account.name: Account
Account.definition: Business relationship between two entities; one entity is the account owner, the other entity is the account servicer.

WaivedTrailerCommissionIndicator.name: Waived Trailer Commission Indicator
WaivedTrailerCommissionIndicator.definition: Non-enforcement of the right to all or part of a commission by the party entitled to the commission.

Role.name: Role
Role.definition: Role or function performed by the intermediary.

PrimaryCommunicationAddress.name: Primary Communication Address
PrimaryCommunicationAddress.definition: Communication device number or electronic address used for communication.

SecondaryCommunicationAddress.name: Secondary Communication Address
SecondaryCommunicationAddress.definition: Communication device number or electronic address used for communication.

NameAndAddress.name: Name And Address
NameAndAddress.definition: Information that locates and identifies a specific address, as defined by postal services.
